page.overview:
Who is Sephraem?

Sephraem was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around.

After the unexpected death of the Amyrlin Seat, Sephraem tried to wrestle control from Elayna Sedai, who had been the most recent Keeper of the Chronicles.
